resources.string: Enjoy a cleaner, more spacious top bar! Creating lists and groups is now neatly tucked under a single + menu.
Fixed an issue where your search text would sometimes hide items unexpectedly when navigating into groups or archives.
Searching for a list that doesn\'t exist? You can now tap the blank empty state to instantly create it!
Added smooth ripple touch effects and intuitive icons to our menus for a premium feel.
Category dropdown logic has been refined and UI layout jumping has been completely eliminated.
